content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on the E-Path FX Platform licence (we are Licensee):

**Critical issues (must fix)**
- **LOL-CAP** — One-way cap at *half* of amounts we have paid, one-way consequential-damages exclusion, express exclusion of Licensor liability for IP infringement, and Article II language making us assume "all liabilities and risks". Redlined to a mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M) with standard Excluded Claims.
- **INDEMN** — Broad one-way indemnity from us; no Licensor indemnity at all. Added Licensor IP/breach-of-law/data-incident/wilful-misconduct indemnity with standard procedure.
- **IP** — Silent on our data; "Intellectual Property Rights" is defined as Licensor's only. Added a Licensee Data ownership sentence and a licence-back for customisations we pay for.

**High severity**
- **T4C** — No convenience exit in a 36-month term; added a 30-day right with pro-rata refund.
- **ASSIGN** — Blanket assignment bar plus automatic termination on our change of control (and a ROFR over a sale of our business). Added affiliate/successor carve-out and removed the CoC trigger.
- **LICENSE** — Grant excludes Affiliates and contractors, is payment-conditioned and effectively revocable; extended and made irrevocable during the term.
- **NONCOMPETE** — No express non-compete, but the Field of Use plus the competitor-acquirer veto operate as an indirect restraint; added a confirmation carve-out.

**Medium / low**
- **RENEWAL** — Licensor's unilateral 7-year extension replaced with mutual 12-month renewals and a capped uplift.
- **NOSOLICIT** — 3-year one-way non-solicit narrowed to a mutual 12-month restriction on involved personnel.
- **WARRANTY** — Pure "AS IS"; added a conformance/workmanlike warranty with a remedy, carved out of the disclaimer.
- **AUDIT** — Unlimited, no-notice audits; added annual frequency, 30 days' notice, no system access (5% cost shift retained).
- **INSURANCE / TRANSITION** — Both absent; inserted standard cover and a data-return/transition-assistance paragraph.

**Compliant, no redline:** GOVLAW (New York law and courts), EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, LD, MINCOMMIT. Worth noting commercially that there are no service credits in our favour anywhere in the agreement.
